data.content:
* * *

## [This was my first time ordering from…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/69f76dd086936fe91b7bf12c)
This was my first time ordering from Lulu and Georgia. I was a bit nervous from some other negative experiences that I read about, but I was only ordering towels so I decided to take the risk. I made sure to order items already in stock and not on back order, which was clearly listed for each item. My towels arrived as expected and they’re very nice. Color is perfect. Good material with no manufacturing defects (like threads needing to be snipped). Towels are light but fluffy. Not overly soft. Happy with them and curious to see how they hold up over time.

April 28, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 4, 2026

Katie,

We appreciate you sharing your first experience with us. We're happy to hear that your towels arrived as expected and that you're pleased with the color and quality. Thank you for your feedback, and we hope you enjoy them for a long time!

Lulu and Georgia
